name: Suzuhara Maki
source:
[url=/c36982]Kudou Seiji[/url]'s girlfriend. She's quite worried about his womanizing ways. She's serious girl who tends to overthink things.

She's a good friend of the protagonist, and at times finds herself having a small crush on him. She holds those feelings back due to a secret she has.
